gui.guhs.herinnering.bel: A memory bubble... there's a little film inside.
gui.guhs.herinnering.bel_gezien: You know this film already. Click the bubble to watch it again.
gui.guhs.herinnering.bel_dicht: The bushes rustle... but this bubble only opens once you've seen the other memories.
gui.guhs.herinnering.persoon: A memory. They look right through you and smile at someone who isn't there any more.
gui.guhs.herinnering.persoon_snoes: A little Snoes, between the leaves. He doesn't see you. He's looking at the party table.
gui.guhs.herinnering.stukje: Piece found: the memory. Now you understand why Snoes never dared to sleep.
scene.guhs.herinnering_quiz.q1: It's the Guh Family Day. Everyone is there. Really, everyone.
scene.guhs.herinnering_quiz.q2: Question three! How many nibbles are in the jar?
scene.guhs.herinnering_quiz.q3: ALL OF THEM! Because I haven't eaten them yet! ...Yet. Njeg!
scene.guhs.herinnering_quiz.q4: Everyone laughs. Behind the bushes, someone laughs along, very quietly.
scene.guhs.herinnering_prik.titel: Memory: pin the tail on the guh
scene.guhs.herinnering_prik.p1: Pin the tail on the guh! With a blindfold on and a little tail in your paw.
scene.guhs.herinnering_prik.p2: Is it here? Here? ...Oh no, this is Grandma's knee.
scene.guhs.herinnering_prik.p3: The tail ended up on the snout. Everyone thought that was fine too.
scene.guhs.herinnering_prik.p4: In the bushes, a little guh held his breath. He had guessed it exactly right. Nobody heard.
scene.guhs.herinnering_koeken.k1: At the long table: pink guh cakes. One for every guh, with icing and big eyes.
scene.guhs.herinnering_koeken.k2: Who hasn't got a cake yet? Paw up!
scene.guhs.herinnering_koeken.k3: Everyone put a paw up. Everyone got one.
scene.guhs.herinnering_koeken.k4: In the end, one was left on the little plate. Nobody knew who it was for.
scene.guhs.herinnering_oma.titel: Memory: Grandma and the family photo
scene.guhs.herinnering_oma.o1: Come here, little ones. All of you. Everyone belongs.
scene.guhs.herinnering_oma.o2: Grandma counted all her grandchildren. Every time, she came up one short.
scene.guhs.herinnering_oma.o3: Oh well. I always count wrong. Another cake, little one?
scene.guhs.herinnering_oma.o4: The family photo was taken at the Guhssenburg. In the photo, very small, a leaf that moves.
scene.guhs.herinnering_snoes.s1: And this one... is Snoes's own.
scene.guhs.herinnering_snoes.s2: He sat here, between the leaves. All day. He watched the quiz, the cakes and the photo.
scene.guhs.herinnering_snoes.s3: I don't have a person. So I don't belong... do I?
scene.guhs.herinnering_snoes.s4: When it got dark, everyone went home. Everyone had a place. Except Snoes.
scene.guhs.herinnering_snoes.s6: That's why he doesn't dare to sleep. If you sleep, you need a place.
